description: Build script for a Rust project that downloads and processes external frontend dependencies, generates inlined assets, and sets runtime configurations such as RPATH for ODBC drivers.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main async function initializing dependencies, spawning download tasks, and setting RPATH.

methods.name: make_client
methods.description: Creates and configures an asynchronous HTTP client with a timeout.

methods.name: download_deps
methods.description: Downloads and processes a dependency file, inlining remote content.

methods.name: process_input_file
methods.description: Processes an input file, inlining remote URLs and compressing output.

methods.name: copy_url_to_opened_file
methods.description: Downloads a URL if not cached and copies its content to an output stream.

methods.name: copy_cached_to_opened_file
methods.description: Copies cached file content to an output stream.

methods.name: download_url_to_path
methods.description: Attempts to download a URL to a local path with retries.

methods.name: hashed_filename
methods.description: Generates a unique filename based on file content hash.

methods.name: make_url_path
methods.description: Creates a filesystem-safe path for a URL in cache.

methods.name: download_tabler_icons
methods.description: Downloads and extracts icon data from a sprite URL into a Rust source file.

methods.name: extract_icons_from_sprite
methods.description: Parses SVG sprite content to extract icon IDs and content.

methods.name: set_odbc_rpath
methods.description: Sets RPATH for ODBC drivers on Linux when feature is enabled.
